source_review.notes: Checked seven official sources. RFC 9110 supplies current HTTP semantics. Current Testcontainers documentation catalogs disposable real-dependency modules. Current Playwright documentation describes per-test browser-context isolation and warns that stored authentication state can impersonate users. Current Kubernetes API concepts document list/watch resource-version behavior and non-guaranteed bookmark intervals. Current OpenTelemetry specification defines distributed traces as spans/events for a logical operation. Current OWASP WSTG covers API security testing. Tools are examples; test claims, fidelity, isolation, safety, evidence and gating remain explicit design decisions.
